references.text: Jeremiah also warns of war and destruction as signs, which is similar to the warning Jesus gives.
Ezekiel speaks of confusion and war, which can be seen as a parallel to Jesus' words about rumors of wars.
Matthew gives a parallel description of Jesus' warning about rumors of wars, as part of the signs before the end times.
Luke gives a similar description to Mark about hearing of wars and uprisings, as part of the signs of the end times.
